verdict.rationale: Firebase documents a drop-in FirebaseUI flow covering email/password and federated providers such as Google and Facebook, and its Authentication SDK has sign-in methods for Google, Facebook, Twitter and GitHub. Community users describe auth and account management as coming 'for free' and as a strength for bootstrapping apps. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of the 'in minutes' setup time (e.g. a quickstart or hands-on timing), and hands-on reports specific to wiring up email/password plus OAuth.
